evidence.title: StocBench: A Benchmark for Generative Modeling of Stochastic Dynamics

summary: StocBench is a novel benchmark designed to assess generative AI models' ability to simulate and predict stochastic dynamic systems. The tool aims to standardize evaluations in fields like physics, finance, and biology where randomness plays a key role.
title: Researchers Introduce StocBench: A New Benchmark for Evaluating AI in Stochastic Dynamics Modeling
